title: Tool bundle manifest
description: bundle.json: what a tool adapter's compile wrote, which values orch must supply, and how to run the tool on the concrete bundle.

plugins.description: Tool plugins the bundle loads, in the tool's own naming.

requires.description: Keys values.json must carry; instantiate refuses a missing one.

environment.description: Environment variable names the entrypoint reads; orch sets placeholder keys, never real credentials.

templates.description: Template files relative to the bundle template directory.

entrypoint.description: Argument vector. {tool_python} is the tool interpreter orch runs; in a template, {bundle} and value keys such as {model} are placeholders that instantiate renders.

values_digest.description: Concrete bundles only: SHA-256 of the canonical values.json that instantiate filled in.

native_outputs.description: Tool output paths relative to the concrete bundle.

repeats.description: Optional; a bundle that omits it is read as {"native": false}. native true means the tool repeats the run by itself, with the count arriving as a requires value; false means orch runs the bundle again for each repeat.

serve.description: Optional; a tool that must be serving before entrypoint runs. argv starts the service (placeholders as in entrypoint); ready_url is a template over the same value keys that answers once the service is ready.
